subject: MIT Scientists Find Aging Stalls the Fluid Waves Clearing Brain Waste
script: From Agewell Brief: MIT Scientists Find Aging Stalls the Fluid Waves Clearing Brain Waste. Rhythmic waves of fluid that flush metabolic debris out of neural tissue during sleep decay with age, linking broken sleep to impaired brain self-cleaning. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
